source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-25 that clearance covers full-page screenshot retention, derivative prompts, and sending screenshots to the pipeline model as visual reference. The source-specific grant was not attached.

provenance.capture: Full-page direct-site captures at 1440x1000 and 390x844 after visiting the whole page to trigger visible scroll reveals and eager image decoding. No source markup or site state was edited; gallery thumbnails were not saved.
provenance.attribution: Mesh Architects is identified as the captured site. Internal reference only; do not redistribute the screenshot or source assets.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A vivid graphic opening leads into warm paper with a brief architecture-practice statement. The portfolio uses uneven project-image scales, short written observations, an occasional side research rail, line-drawing notes, and a direct service list. The page closes on a dark contact panel. Source projects, identity, photos, any number-like hero mark, and claims belong to Mesh Architects and are not client facts.

heroGeometry.mode: full-screen graphic color field with oversized abstract serial mark
heroGeometry.alignment: graphic marker centered in opening; factual architecture statement follows on warm paper before a varied project collage
heroGeometry.viewport: color field and enough of the factual practice statement appear at the first desktop fold

navigationGeometry.mode: micro wordmark and restrained text anchors
navigationGeometry.placement: small top-edge strip over or above the opening field
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact menu with visible brand and contact access

typography.display: bold expressive grotesk with compact editorial serif accents
typography.scale: large graphic brand mark, concise practice statement, small project captions and fine service labels

palette.contrastIntent: graphic opening contrast transitions to readable warm editorial project chapters

imageTreatment.mode: loose project collage interleaved with annotations and line drawings
imageTreatment.crop: mixed tall and wide crops with varied image scale
imageTreatment.focalPoint: architectural space and material detail, never inferred client proof

servicePresentation.pattern: type-led service index following an irregular portfolio sequence
servicePresentation.interaction: direct service anchors and restrained project links

ctaPlacement.primary: project enquiry in the opening statement and dark closing panel
ctaPlacement.early: small consultation action directly after the practice statement

motion.primitive: subtle reveal of project notes and image groupings
motion.reducedMotion: all project and service content visible in static order

rules: scale the graphic opening without presenting it as a metric
interleave side-rail notes between project entries
preserve alternation between image and short text
keep service and contact routes visible

prohibitedPatterns: copied brand, logo, exact orange color, project images or words
invented project outcomes or client relationships

requiredSignatureElements.description: strong graphic field before the concise local practice statement
varied project imagery and short factual annotations
secondary research or process notes, responsive to mobile flow
services expressed as a compact typographic index

acceptanceChecks: graphic mark is not interpreted as a business statistic
service and location context are present in the opening text
project assets and claims are client-approved
mobile preserves an intentional image/text rhythm
no source brand, copy, image or award is reused

review.scope: direct-site desktop/mobile capture, source-specific mechanics prompt and requester attestation; no source grant file uploaded
